subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Series vs Shunt: Winding Configurations
description: A quick win: understand Series vs Shunt: Winding Configurations.

hook.text: How you wire the field coil changes everything about a DC motor's behavior.

buildup.text: In a series motor, field and armature windings carry the same current. Torque is enormous at startup.

discovery.text: In a shunt motor, the field coil connects in parallel. Speed stays nearly constant under load.

twist.text: A series motor with no load can accelerate dangerously fast — it must never run unloaded.

climax.text: Subway trains used series motors for their massive starting torque on heavy cars.

punchline.text: Series for brute force, shunt for steady speed — wiring defines character.

quiz.question: Why must a series DC motor never run without a load?
options: It will overheat due to excessive current
Without load, it accelerates to dangerously high speeds
The field coil will demagnetize permanently
